headline: Tight grid ahead: 19 red hours. Strain peaks Sat 5 pm · 71% spike risk Sun 5 pm

tips.text: Pre-cool your home before 3 pm, then let the thermostat drift up a few degrees until 1 am.
Run laundry and the dishwasher during 10 am – 2 pm.
Charge the EV during 1 am – 5 am, when strain is lowest.
Unplug or delay non-essential loads during red hours.

why_red.2026-11-07T22:00:00Z: 4 pm is red because low wind (4.5 GW) and solar fading leave a big gap for gas plants to fill, putting net load near the top of its range for this month, with a 68% chance of a price spike.
